fifteen-01.instruction: Arrange the numbered tiles in ascending row-major order, with the empty cell at bottom right.
fifteen-01.rules: Click a tile in the same row or column as the gap to slide it. Undo and restart are allowed. Solve and changing the puzzle are prohibited.

reference.provenance: Offline native solution translated to ordinary mouse actions; replayed in native midend without solve. Not an agent rollout.

curriculum.difficulty_rationale: 3 by 3 layout; 1 misplaced tiles and total tile Manhattan distance 1. Exact shortest native multi-tile-click solution: 1 moves. Gap routing must restore row and column ordering without displacing already settled tiles. Author estimate; not empirically calibrated.

net-3x3.instruction: Rotate the wire tiles until the entire network is connected with no dangling ends.
net-3x3.rules: Rotate tiles with left/right click to connect all wires to the central power source. No wires may end without a matching connection. Middle click locks a tile. Undo is allowed; Solve and changing the puzzle are prohibited.

curriculum.difficulty_rationale: Board parameters 3x3; 9 tiles require reciprocal local joins and one connected global network; larger boards contain more interacting branches. Author estimate; not empirically calibrated.
